_comment: Catalog name to candidate symbol where the two names differ at the same retail address. Every entry states why the address, not the name, is authoritative.

0x0048F530.reason: the port's Main implements this entry; the catalog name Retail_Main is descriptive

0x00498460.reason: retail body is fnstcw/fldcw of the global control word; the catalog name Display_ClearSurfaces_16 does not describe this address

0x004A7157.reason: retail body sets the default x87 control word; the catalog camera name does not describe this address

0x004AC620.reason: retail body is fnstcw/fldcw merge of an argument control word; the catalog camera name does not describe this address

0x004AC655.reason: retail body merges an argument control word with denormals masked

0x004AC66B.reason: retail body decodes the x87 control word into flag bits

0x004AC6FD.reason: retail body encodes flag bits into an x87 control word

0x004F82B0.reason: the port implements this address as PushEntry; the catalog suffix _Init_2 is not the ported name

0x004F1160.reason: retail body reads the two global mode bytes; the catalog name Script_ParseEnumReal32_5 does not describe this address

0x00497E70.reason: same symbol, catalog capitalises the T in Context

0x0048F260.reason: the port implements the lightmaps-enabled setter at this address; the catalog name AppContext_SetTerrainLightmapsUsed describes the same behaviour

0x00517940.reason: the port's chunk walker is a namespaced C++ function, not an extern C symbol

0x00517890.reason: the port's form child search is a namespaced C++ function

0x005178E0.reason: the port's below-form search is a namespaced C++ function
